sentences.text: In an upset, behold the lamb, 11th before the week, beat 2nd-place Bo Girds.
The drops cost Bo Girds the game: its starters dropped passes worth about 17.8 against a margin of 5.34.
Matthew Golden did his share for Bo Girds, dropping 3 passes worth about 14.2 on his own.
Recent add Germie Bernard, a waiver pickup, was the lucky decider with 20.2 on a 8.13 projection.
Bo Girds also made a free agent add, and the Indianapolis Colts returned -0.85.
behold the lamb is now 6-6 and sitting right at the cut, while CeeDee Lamb, the team's apparent namesake, scored 11.5.
The Game Changer is Germie Bernard, a recent add who scored 20.2 for behold the lamb.
He finished 12.07 over projection, which makes a week 5 waiver claim look lucky rather than smart.
Bo Girds came in 2nd and lost by 5.34 to behold the lamb, an upset by a team that was 11th before the week.
Bernard decided it with a position rank of 3 among started WRs, and without him, that is a loss.
Bo Girds also dropped 7 passes worth about 17.8, so the drops cost the game before the lamb needed any help.
Germie Bernard is the Game Changer for behold the lamb, a lucky recent add who scored 20.2 in a win by 5.34.
The Underperformer is Bijan Robinson of To Infinity and Bijan, 16.78 under projection, which is not much infinity for 6.3 points.
London Cooking left the MVB on its bench, Jayden Daniels with 21, and still won by 66.4.
Butterfingers goes to Matthew Golden of Bo Girds, whose 3 drops were worth about 14.2 points.
Lil Fridge beat Brock ‘N’ Roll by 38.48, and the team named for Brock got its Top Scorer from Brock Purdy at a modest 17.36.
Brock ‘N’ Roll's recent adds both beat projection, the Tampa Bay Buccaneers at 9.65 and Dallas Goedert at 9.1, so the waiver wire held up its end.
Lil Fridge got a lucky 13.35 from recent add Denver Broncos, while Davante Adams and Mike Evans are now listed Out and Romeo Doubs is now listed IR.
Return of T Mac beat Unsolicited Dak Picks by 38.82, an upset only on paper, since the winner started the week 9th.
Lucky recent add Carnell Tate went for 16, while Unsolicited Dak Picks answered with recent add Kimani Vidal at 5.5.
The team named for Dak got 13.02 from Dak on the way to a season low of 81.47, and A.J. Brown is now listed Questionable.
Isaiah Likely was the decider for Maye d'force B with U, finishing 9.84 over projection in a 9.51-point win over Amon-Ra Dawg Your Team.
Amon-Ra Dawg Your Team got 6.4 from recent add Garrett Wilson and 7.3 from recent add Dalton Kincaid, who is now listed Questionable, so the trade desk remains open for business.
Jaylen Waddle, now listed Questionable, scored 4.4 for the winners, and Amon-Ra Dawg Your Team still found a way to fall to 4-8.
behold the lamb beat Bo Girds by 5.34, an upset pulled off by a team that started the week 11th.
Recent add Germie Bernard was the lucky decider, scoring 20.2 on a 8.13 projection.
Bo Girds's starters dropped passes worth about 17.8, which cost the game, and recent add Indianapolis Colts chipped in -0.85.
London Cooking beat To Infinity and Bijan by 66.4, and Bijan Robinson scored 6.3 for the team that bears his name.
Recent add Rhamondre Stevenson scored 3.6 and recent add Harold Fannin scored 1.4, so the trade desk has been very active and not very effective.
Recent adds Ladd McConkey and Terry McLaurin scored 2.2 and 3.2, and both are now listed Out, McConkey with a concussion and McLaurin with a knee, so the trades are going great.
Tre Tucker decided this one for All You Need Is Love, clearing his projection by 16.62; without him, that is a loss.
Pukancun on 3 traded for recent add Cam Skattebo, started him, and got 0 points, which tracks for a team now 1-11.
Recent add Aaron Rodgers was lucky at 17.02, enough cover for a Jacksonville Jaguars defense at -4.4 as All You Need Is Love won anyway.
Pukancun on 3, at 1-9 and 12th, at least earns credit for doing something.
The something was giving up Omarion Hampton at 9.4 points per game and Tony Pollard with 17 red-zone carries.
In return came David Montgomery, whose target share fell to 0 percent, and Jacory Croskey-Merritt, whose snap share is down to 40 percent.
Amon-Ra Dawg Your Team, at 4-6, gets Hampton, the top position rank by season points in the deal, plus Pollard's flat 50 percent snap share.
This week Pukancun on 3 parked its new backs on the bench for 0 points, while the backs it sent away started for 13.5.
To Infinity and Bijan sat 10th before the trade and responded by downgrading at tight end, sending Dalton Kincaid to Amon-Ra Dawg Your Team for Kenyon Sadiq.
Kincaid left at 8.3 points per game and Sadiq arrived at 6.4, a bold purchase for a team that needed a move.
Sadiq also shows up with his snap share down to 34 percent, so To Infinity and Bijan paid in production for a part-time role.
Amon-Ra Dawg Your Team got the tight end ranked 12th by season points for the one ranked 22nd, a clean upgrade even with Kincaid's target share trending down.
This week Kincaid scored 7.3 for Amon-Ra Dawg Your Team while Sadiq scored 1.7 on the To Infinity and Bijan bench, which tracks.
Pukancun on 3 was 1-9 and dead last, so swapping Ladd McConkey and Rhamondre Stevenson for Cam Skattebo and Nico Collins counts as a pulse.
Collins arrived with 17.7 points per game and a 26 percent target share, while McConkey left with a target share that was going down.
To Infinity and Bijan, sitting 4-6, gave up that receiver and took back McConkey at position rank 55.
Stevenson beating projection in 2 of the last 3 weeks is the consolation prize for a team named after a different running back.
This week the new arrivals went 9.4 to 5.8 in Pukancun on 3's favor, not enough to change either matchup.
Bo Girds, 7-3 and 2nd, sent Patrick Mahomes and Brian Robinson to To Infinity and Bijan for Lamar Jackson, which is the kind of quarterback bet a contender can afford.
Jackson trails Mahomes at 20 points per game, his snap share was down, and he was listed Out in week 5, so Bo Girds is paying for upside rather than recent output.
With 4 RB still on the roster, Bo Girds can spare Brian Robinson and his 31 percent snap share.

To Infinity and Bijan, sitting 10th, needed a move and got the quarterback with more points per game plus a running back ranked 20th by season points, a fair haul for a team whose name promises a running back.
This week, Mahomes scored 11.48 for To Infinity and Bijan while Jackson scored 0 on the Bo Girds bench, which is one way to hold an upside bet.
Unsolicited Dak Picks shipped out Garrett Wilson, whose target share was up to 34 percent, plus Bhayshul Tuten at 11.8 points per game.
Back came Devaughn Vele at 9.9 points per game and Josh Jacobs, who had no scored game before the trade.
That leaves Unsolicited Dak Picks with 6 RB after the trade, a deep running back room bought by giving away the rising one, so it earns a D.
Amon-Ra Dawg Your Team gets an A for landing Wilson at 14.2 points per game and Tuten, whose snap share was up to 64 percent.
This week Tuten scored 22.7 for Amon-Ra Dawg Your Team, while Josh Jacobs scored 0 on the bench for Unsolicited Dak Picks.
To Infinity and Bijan traded away Bijan Robinson, position rank 2 by season points, and kept the team name, which is a bold branding choice.
At 4-6, To Infinity and Bijan needed a shake-up, and Malik Nabers arrived with a 33 percent target share that was trending up.
Jared Goff adds 22.8 points per game, though Breece Hall was listed Out on the injury report in week 5, so the return comes with homework.
Return of T Mac consolidated into Bijan Robinson and his 20 red-zone carries, while Marvin Harrison at 4.3 points per game came along as luggage.
In the trade week, Bijan Robinson scored 6.3 for To Infinity and Bijan, a quiet farewell to the namesake.
The league median was 106.83, and Lil Fridge cleared it by 19.97 without much visible effort.
To Infinity and Bijan posted a season low of 46.08, which landed 60.75 below the median.
Unsolicited Dak Picks also found its season low at 81.47, a fitting week for a 4-8 team.
Amon-Ra Dawg Your Team missed the median by 2.79, the exact amount Bo Girds cleared it by.
The Must Watch is Lil Fridge at 10-2 against Return of T Mac, which has won 3 straight and now draws the toughest next opponent win rate in the league.
Both below the cut, Pukancun on 3 at 1-11 meets To Infinity and Bijan at 4-8, a showdown of the awful that someone has to win.
